# vector spec extract

Extract a contract from a kramdown-rfc spec's XML.

## Usage

```text
vector spec extract <spec.xml> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;spec.xml&gt;" required>

the spec, RFC XML v3

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="-o, --out" type="&lt;contract.json&gt;">

where to write the contract

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--check">

write nothing; exit 1 with a diff if --out differs

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>

## Exit codes

0 when the check passed, 1 when `vector` refused the input, 2 for bad usage or an I/O or tool failure; see [exit codes](../command-line.md#exit-codes).
